review.summary: The +8 ended after a Merektha wipe. Exact damage reveals an oversized shared-soak hit on the first boss, Burrow and storm-pool pressure, then overlapping Knot of Snakes and Thunder Spit damage. The incident tables distinguish lethal events from nearby damage and show practical prevention.
whatWentWell: Adderis and Aspix was killed in 2:49 despite one player death.
Rinse’s Desperate Prayer and healing potion were recorded at 11:44:55–11:44:56 during the Merektha attempt. Healing continued after entry into Spirit of Redemption.

improvements.text: Merektha — move the hazards, then heal the pressure. Thunder Spit target: carry the circles toward the arena edge; keep moving out of each new circle.
Merektha — shorten the dangerous add phase. Tank: gather the snakes for cleave; DPS: prioritize the Storm Serpent.
Adderis & Aspix — regroup after the knockback. Spread for Gale Force lines; immediately return to melee afterward for the shared Thunder and Lightning soak.

nextRunPriorities.text: Merektha: leave each Thunder Spit circle immediately and keep a clean knockback landing area.
Rinse: enter Merektha with a planned Serpentstorm healing cooldown; use the live cast cue, not these historical timestamps.
First boss: call “back into melee” after Gale Force so the shared soak is covered.

healerReview: Your correction: regroup for the first-boss soak and spot-heal Gust targets. On Merektha, dodge Burrow (380,179 damage recorded on you at 11:44:51), call for Knot removal if trapped, and prepare healing from safe ground. No Lingering Storm hits were recorded on you; this does not mean no avoidable damage.
Within the start-to-wipe window, Rinse recorded two Divine Hymn channel starts (spell 64843), one Guardian Spirit on Daedara, one Desperate Prayer and one healing potion.
No successful Rinse SPELL_DISPEL event was recorded in this attempt. That is not evidence of a missed dispel without establishing dispellable effects and opportunity.

bossNotes.note: Killed in 169 seconds. Hellherox died at 11:34:52 with Thunder and Lightning as the last logged hit, following Gust damage. Recalculated heal-event HPS: 66,550 (separate from shield absorption).

The 261-second attempt ended in a wipe with six death events. Nahii died after Lingering Storm; later Äkhirà died to Thunder Spit and Hellherox to A Knot of Snakes. Rinse took Thunder Spit around entry into Spirit of Redemption at 11:45:49. See the timestamped damage tables for the overlapping hits. Heal-event HPS: 81,383, excluding separate shield absorption.

groupVsHealer.text: The Merektha wipe involved repeated and clustered deaths across the party. Healing and group mitigation warrant review together; the log does not prove sole healer responsibility.

evidenceLimits: Based on combat-log version 22, build 12.1.0. Dates and times use the log's local clock; timezone is not recorded.

Death totals count player UNIT_DIED events, including repeat deaths after resurrection; they are not the number of unique players who died. Spirit of Redemption delays Rinse's death marker by about 15 seconds.

Spell cast-success entries can include triggered effects and channel ticks. Divine Hymn casts are counted using spell 64843, not its 64844 ticks. A recorded cooldown cast does not prove that it prevented a death.
The +8 and +7 had different teammates and difficulty, so their outcomes are not a controlled measure of healer improvement.

Duration is deliberately unavailable: the later failed/reset marker at 12:24:57 includes a long gap and pre-run activity with a new group. The displayed end time is the last recorded boss encounter end, not a certified challenge abandonment time. Only the original party and the start-to-wipe window are used for coaching.

Mechanics researched online on 2026-09-02. Sources describe Midnight Season 2 but do not certify the exact log build/hotfix state. Mechanic prevention is distinguished from individual blame and guaranteed survival.

Boss heal-event HPS was recalculated from the original file. All 9,763 included healing events passed the 36-field layout and numeric checks. HPS is not a skill rating; shield absorption is excluded, and Avatar-target healing must not be confused with party healing.

tactics.title: Merektha — move the hazards, then heal the pressure
tactics.evidence: Nahii died after Lingering Storm at 11:44:55; Knot of Snakes and Thunder Spit overlap during the 11:45:48–49 collapse.
tactics.assessment: Ground-hazard prevention is supported. Individual movement mistakes and cooldown availability remain unproven.
steps: Thunder Spit target: carry the circles toward the arena edge; keep moving out of each new circle.
Before Serpentstorm: choose clean ground behind you so the knockback cannot put you in old pools.
Rinse: prepare group healing for Serpentstorm. If targeted by Thunder Spit, move first; do not finish a cast in a hazard.

tactics.title: Merektha — shorten the dangerous add phase
tactics.evidence: The failed boss attempt lasted 261 seconds and included six death events.
tactics.assessment: Recommended execution plan; this duration alone does not prove poor add targeting.
steps: Tank: gather the snakes for cleave; DPS: prioritize the Storm Serpent.
For Knot of Snakes, group the targets and use crowd control to release them; clear the spawned snakes.
Everyone: dodge Burrow. Rinse: reserve a major healing cooldown for Serpentstorm rather than spending every tool on the preceding trash.

tactics.title: Adderis & Aspix — regroup after the knockback
tactics.evidence: Hellherox died at 11:34:52 after Gust and Thunder and Lightning.
tactics.assessment: Only one damage recipient is logged for the lethal soak; insufficient shared coverage is likely, but exact positions and immunities are not audited.
steps: Spread for Gale Force lines; immediately return to melee afterward for the shared Thunder and Lightning soak.
Rinse: spot-heal Gust targets before the soak hits. Drop Tempest Winds away from the regroup point.

review.tacticsNote: These are next-pull instructions. Source-backed tactics and proposed healer execution are distinguished from proven errors. Use encounter cues; timestamps identify this recorded run, not a universal cooldown schedule.

incidents.title: 11:34:52 — first-boss shared soak
incidents.observed: Hellherox is the only SPELL_DAMAGE recipient logged for Thunder and Lightning at 11:34:52.035, immediately before death. The later two soaks each have four damage recipients.
incidents.finding: Likely insufficient shared-soak coverage; damage recipients are not a complete positioning or immunity audit.
incidents.correction: After Gale Force, everyone returns to the melee soak promptly. Rinse participates while spot-healing Gust targets.
incidents.damageSummary: Thunder and Lightning hit Hellherox for 969,178 (140.8% of the logged 688,138 maximum HP), including 398,520 overkill. Earlier Gust hits dealt 77,585 and 42,509. This was a death in a successful boss kill, not the run-ending wipe.
incidents.preventability: Likely preventable through correct shared-soak coverage. With the recorded mitigation, the soak hit exceeded full health: topping up alone would not cover it. Sharing the hit or additional mitigation was needed; exact survival with a different group response is not proven.
incidents.deathCountMethod: Deaths associated with this reviewed incident. Rinse is attributed to the lethal sequence leading to Spirit of Redemption, not the delayed UNIT_DIED timestamp. Selected incidents do not cover every death in the run.

incidents.title: 11:44:55 — lethal ground damage on Merektha
incidents.observed: Nahii takes Lingering Storm from Storm Serpent at 11:44:55.307 and dies at 11:44:55.313. Rinse has no Lingering Storm hit recorded in this boss attempt.
incidents.finding: Confirmed hazard damage at death. It is not evidence that Rinse stood in the pool.
incidents.correction: Dodge the Burrow charge; position the Storm Serpent and its new pool toward the edge, then leave the pool immediately. Rinse also needs to dodge Burrow while healing the unavoidable background pressure.
incidents.owner: Affected player movement and tank placement
incidents.damageSummary: Nahii took Burrow for 371,314, Storm Catalyst for 370,734, then a lethal Lingering Storm tick for 128,103 with 117,708 overkill. These are separate hits with healing and other damage between them, not one combined strike. Rinse also took a 380,179 Burrow hit earlier in this sequence.
incidents.preventability: The ground tick is avoidable-type damage; Burrow can also be dodged. Storm Catalyst and prior damage left recovery pressure, so the last tick alone does not explain the whole death. Movement restrictions and available recovery tools remain unverified.
incidents.deathCountMethod: Deaths associated with this reviewed incident. Rinse is attributed to the lethal sequence leading to Spirit of Redemption, not the delayed UNIT_DIED timestamp. Selected incidents do not cover every death in the run.

incidents.title: 11:45:48–49 — party collapse
incidents.observed: The log separates two Thunder Spit spell IDs from A Knot of Snakes. Äkhirà takes a lethal 1291734 Thunder Spit hit at 11:45:48.9231. Hellherox's lethal event at 11:45:49.3101 is A Knot of Snakes. Rinse takes Thunder Spit at 11:45:49.9281 around entry into Spirit of Redemption.
incidents.finding: Confirmed overlapping mechanics, with Knot damage directly lethal to Hellherox. The earlier review overemphasized Thunder Spit for that death. Rinse's zero overkill value must not be read as proof of survival because Spirit of Redemption changes death reporting.
incidents.correction: Knot targets regroup in melee for an available AoE crowd-control effect to break the knots; kill the released snakes. Thunder Spit targets place circles at the outside and move clear; use a defensive for its targeted damage if needed. Rinse calls for release if trapped. Plan healing for unavoidable pressure after mechanic control.
incidents.owner: Group crowd control and targeted-player placement; healer recovery
incidents.damageSummary: Äkhirà: three 97,227 Thunder Spit hits, then 486,140 (123,867 overkill). Hellherox: five 51,010 Knot ticks in this selected window; the last records 42,715 overkill. Rinse: five Knot ticks totaling 242,894, then 485,784 Thunder Spit. Totals include intervening healing and are not HP deficits.
incidents.preventability: Potentially preventable through prompt Knot removal and safe Thunder Spit placement. Repeated Knot ticks indicate the effect remained active in this window; available crowd control and movement freedom are not established. Extra HPS alone is not a proven solution.
incidents.deathCountMethod: Deaths associated with this reviewed incident. Rinse is attributed to the lethal sequence leading to Spirit of Redemption, not the delayed UNIT_DIED timestamp. Selected incidents do not cover every death in the run.

review.damageMethod: Selected SPELL_DAMAGE and SPELL_PERIODIC_DAMAGE events from the original log. Hit damage is field 31 in the validated 42-field layout, after recorded mitigation/absorption and including overkill; field 33 is shown separately as overkill (negative becomes zero). Field 32 is not used as hit damage. Do not add shield absorption or subtract overkill again from the displayed hit. These are selected incident windows, not complete death recaps or net HP loss; heals and other damage may occur between rows. Maximum HP comparisons use target field 15. Zero overkill does not prove survival, especially with Spirit of Redemption.

bossHealing.method: HPS = sum of Rinse SPELL_HEAL and SPELL_PERIODIC_HEAL amount minus overheal, divided by full ENCOUNTER_START-to-END seconds. Includes heal-absorbed amounts and Rinse-attributed procs; excludes separate SPELL_ABSORBED shields, pet-source heals, pre/post-fight healing and indirect orb healing. Includes time dead and Spirit of Redemption. All-target HPS includes player, pet/NPC and Avatar healing; player-only and Avatar columns are separate. This is a defined heal-event HPS, not a Warcraft Logs score or total including shields.

deathRecaps.method: Each recap covers 10 seconds before UNIT_DIED, or before Spirit of Redemption (27827) with a 50 ms grace period to include its triggering hit. Every player death in the original-party run windows is represented once. Damage: SPELL_DAMAGE/PERIODIC/RANGE fields 31/33, SWING_DAMAGE_LANDED 28/30 (do not double count SWING_DAMAGE), environmental 29/31. Values include overkill. Healing: SPELL_HEAL/PERIODIC amount minus overheal (32−33); not a reconstructed health bar. Separate absorb events, misses and shields are excluded. Selected survival/utility casts and tracked defensive aura changes are shown; absence is not proof a defensive was unused, unavailable or unnecessary. Aura effects already active before the window are not audited. Healing and damage totals must not be subtracted to infer survival.
